meanings.context: group of homes with a private entrance

m.t: Parece que sabes lo que sucede en mi vida privada.
m.e: You seem to know a lot about what's happening in my private life.

m.t: Mi padre siempre mete la nariz en mi vida privada.
m.e: My father is always poking his nose into my private life.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #746186 by darinmex; English translation #251630 by CK

m.t: Esta es una discusión privada entre mi marido y yo.
m.e: This is a private discussion between me and my husband.

m.t: Él tuvo el privilegio de una educación privada.
m.e: He had the privilege of a private education.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #718650 by darinmex; English translation #306470 by CM

m.t: ¿Cuánto era tu tarifa de sesión privada por hora?
m.e: What was your hourly private practice rate?

m.t: ¿Así que estás diciendo que nunca puedo tener una vida privada en este sitio?
m.e: So are you saying I can never have a personal life in this place?

m.t: ¿Cómo se alcanza el equilibrio entre el trabajo y la vida privada?
m.e: How is it possible to reconcile work and private life?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1866482 by al_ex_an_der; English translation #1866528 by al_ex_an_der

m.t: Mi madre está siempre inmiscuyéndose en mi vida privada.
m.e: My mother is always poking her nose into my private life.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #855640 by fran_trujillo; English translation #320625 by CK

m.t: El actor se quedó sin palabras al preguntársele sobre su vida privada.
m.e: The actor became speechless when he was questioned about his private affairs.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #986565 by Shishir; English translation #1324277 by marcelostockle

m.t: Cursé la mayor parte de la secundaria en una escuela privada.
m.e: I attended a private school for most of high school.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2911902 by hayastan; English translation #7482812 by shekitten

m.t: ¿Esta compañía es pública ó privada?
m.e: Is this a public or private company?
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #456076 by lukaszpp; English translation #456075 by lukaszpp

m.t: "Porque todos han pecado y son privados de la gloria de Dios".
m.e: "For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God."

m.t: Si los fumadores son privados de sus cigarrillos, se ponen nerviosos e irritables.
m.e: If people who smoke are deprived of their cigarettes, they get nervous and irritable.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1475390 by marcelostockle; English translation #19925 by CK

m.t: ¿Volar en sus aviones privados a áreas de desastre para poder "ayudar"?
m.e: Flying their private jets to disaster areas so they can "help out"?

m.t: Ahora volveré con mis libros y mis pensamientos privados.
m.e: Now I'll return to my books and my private thoughts.

m.t: Y después hiciste un espectáculo público con mis pensamientos más privados.
m.e: And then you made my most private thoughts a public spectacle.

m.t: En los años '90 saqué muchos fondos privados de pensión.
m.e: I took out a lot of private pensions in the '90s, you know.

m.t: Así que guarden sus pensamientos privados para sí mismos.
m.e: So keep your breathy thoughts to yourself.

m.t: Él no deja que nadie interfiera en sus asuntos privados.
m.e: He doesn't let anyone interfere with his private matters.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2700791 by migeels; English translation #2895469 by mervert1

m.t: Debes asumir que los e-mails no son privados.
m.e: You should assume that email messages aren't private.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1419541 by marcelostockle; English translation #1096296 by CK

m.t: Mañana se prohibirá el tránsito de vehículos privados por el centro de la ciudad.
m.e: Tomorrow it will be prohibited to drive private vehicles downtown.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #5720494 by arh; English translation #7799906 by shekitten

m.t: Debe haber algunos contratistas privados importantes detrás de eso.
m.e: Must have some major private contractors behind that.

m.t: Debemos trazar la línea entre asuntos públicos y privados.
m.e: We should draw the line between public and private affairs.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1279680 by marcelostockle; English translation #240467 by \N

m.t: Puedes olvidarte de colegios privados para los chicos.
m.e: You could forget private schools for the kids.

m.t: ¿O prefiere que lo hagan los capitalistas privados?
m.e: Or would you rather let private capitalists do that?

m.t: Contratistas privados en la región que podrían ayudarnos.
m.e: Private contractors in the region that might be of help.

m.t: No lleves a tus hijos a colegios privados.
m.e: Do not send your kids to private schools.

m.t: ¿Cuántos canales privados hay en Grecia?
m.e: How many private channels are there in Greece?

m.t: Bueno, hay colegios privados aquí.
m.e: Well, there are private schools here.

m.e: In the US and the UK, prisons are being turned into lucrative private businesses.

m.t: Y un grupo de inversores privados
m.e: And a group of private investors

m.t: No deberías mirar las cosas privadas de otras personas.
m.e: Shouldn't go looking through other people's private things.

m.t: Los chicos de las escuelas privadas se asustan rápido.
m.e: Private school kids, they get scared fast.

m.t: Y no debería hacerlo, pero las escuelas privadas hablan.
m.e: And it shouldn't have, but private schools talk.

m.t: Su oro robado paga las escuelas privadas de mis hijos.
m.e: His looted gold pays for my kids' private schools.

m.t: Le puse una toalla sobre sus partes privadas.
m.e: Okay, I put a towel over his private parts.

m.t: Salen a caminar juntos, han tenido conversaciones privadas.
m.e: Going for walks together, having private conversations.

m.t: No deberías leer las cartas privadas de la gente sin su permiso.
m.e: You shouldn't read people's private letters without permission.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1437440 by peibolvig; English translation #19385 by Zifre

m.t: La teniente y yo hacemos lo posible por separar nuestras vidas privadas.
m.e: The lieutenant and I do our best to keep our personal lives separate.

m.t: Y solo vimos a tu papá en sus meditaciones privadas.
m.e: And all we saw was your dad doing his private meditations.

m.t: ¿Me dices que las personas están hackeando las conversaciones privadas?
m.e: You're telling me that people are hacking private chats?

m.t: Le costó a varias empresas privadas millones.
m.e: It cost multiple private companies millions.

m.t: Las escuelas privadas en Los Ángeles son una locura.
m.e: L.A. private schools are insane.

m.t: El número de universidades privadas ha crecido.
m.e: The number of private colleges has increased.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1737339 by marcelostockle; English translation #263336 by CK

m.t: Las facultades y universidades privadas de Estados Unidos son autónomas.
m.e: The private colleges and universities of the United States are autonomous.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #10051207 by manufrutos; English translation #1911 by AlanF_US

m.t: Y ella es más americana de lo que podrán ser ustedes.
m.e: And she is more American than you'll ever be!

m.e: I never thought I'd like this American music so much, but now I do.

m.e: You think America's War on Drugs is a joke.

m.e: I gave him his first roll of duct tape that day.

m.t: Soy un gran admirador de la cultura americana.
m.e: I am a great admirer of American culture.

m.e: Disney films are an American vision of society.

m.e: American politics are interesting to watch, especially during a presidential election.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #1433038 by inmachan; English translation #67570 by CK

m.t: Hay una chica americana que quiere verte.

m.b: Tatoeba sentence #2420334 by Shishir; English translation #71089 by CM

m.t: Él tiene acceso a la embajada americana.

m.t: Ellos son de una empresa americana.

m.t: El tomate es una planta americana.
m.e: The tomato is an American plant.

m.t: Es una americana importante.

m.b: Tatoeba sentence #875852 by alexmarcelo; English translation #875853 by CM

m.e: Still, female American... both staying in the 18th arrondissement.

m.e: I don't think American girls get me.

m.e: I learned from American songs and TV.

m.e: American ladies are too noisy but they can't help it.

m.t: Dejar que las tropas americanas defiendan la paz mundial.
m.e: Let the US troops defend world peace.

m.t: Un lugar para develar secretos para salvar vidas Americanas.
m.e: A place where we can unlock secrets to save American lives.

m.e: Athletic boys are popular with girls in American schools.

m.e: One of us has been getting American samples of pathogens.

m.t: Las cocinas americanas son mucho más grandes que las japonesas.
m.e: American kitchens are much bigger than Japanese ones.
m.b: Tatoeba sentence #608626 by arashi_29; English translation #67564 by CK

m.t: Si informamos de esto... dirán que nos quedemos hasta que lleguen las tropas americanas.
m.e: If we report this, we'll be told to stay away until the US troops get here.

m.t: No confies en las chicas, especialmente las americanas.
m.e: Don't trust girls, especially Americans.

m.t: Las mujeres afro‐americanas de mediana edad son mi demo.
m.e: Middle aged African‐American women are my demo.

m.t: Prefiero las películas francesas a las americanas.
m.e: I prefer French films to American ones.

m.e: American forces were withdrawn.

m.t: Los inspectores no la relacionaron inmediatamente con las americanas, hasta que vieron esto.
m.e: My inspectors didn't immediately connect her with the American women until they saw this.

m.t: Su tía cuida de su perro durante el día.
m.e: His aunt takes care of his dog during the day.

m.e: She looks after the girls, and, you know, I work for church.

m.t: Mi abuela cuida a los niños durante el día.
m.e: Grandmother looks after the children during the day.

m.e: Look after your mum and sister, will you?

m.e: Look after the cat while I'm away.

m.e: Look after the children this afternoon.

m.t: Siempre pensando en las grandes ideas, nunca cuidando de las pequeñas cosas.
m.e: Always thinking about big ideas? Never remembering to take care of little things?

m.t: Yo soy la que supone que debe estar cuidando de ti.
m.e: I'm the one who's supposed to be taking care of you.

m.t: Tal vez seamos mejores cuidando de otras personas que de nosotros.
m.e: Maybe we're better at looking after other people than each other.

m.t: Estoy cuidando el jardín estos días sólo para matar el tiempo.
m.e: I am gardening these days just to kill time.

m.e: Okay, well, then, I appreciate you looking out for me. Daniel.

m.t: Podría darte un poco de espacio, podrías relajarte, cuidarte.
m.e: It could give you a little space, you could relax, take care of yourself.

m.t: Me quiero casar contigo y cuidarte el resto de la vida.
m.e: I want to marry you and take care of you for the rest of your life.

m.t: Si no pasa nada más, yo puedo cuidarte.
m.e: If anything else happens, I can take care of it.

m.t: Todos trataron de cuidarte, y tú no hiciste sino ser malvado con ellos.
m.e: Everyone tried to take care of you, and you were nothing but mean to them.

m.t: Es como tu mami, puede cuidarte.
m.e: It's like your mummy, it can look after you.

m.t: Me envió a cuidarte.
m.e: He sent me to look after you.

m.t: Quiero cuidarte, mi ángel.
m.e: I want to look after you, my angel.

m.t: Debemos cuidarte, esconderte aquí entre nosotras.
m.e: We shall care for you, hide you here amongst us.

m.t: Tú solo tienes que preocuparte por cuidarme a mí.
m.e: All you have to worry about is taking care of me.

m.t: Sólo quiero saber si hay algo de lo que debería cuidarme.
m.e: I just want to know if there's something I should look out for.

m.t: Quería quedarse para cuidarme, pero le dije que tenía que ir.
m.e: He wanted to stay to take care of me, but I told him he had to go.

m.t: Gracias por cuidarme tan bien y ser buen hermano.
m.e: Thanks for taking such good care of me and being a good brother.

m.t: Porque no quiero que tengas que cuidarme y... nunca quiero ser una carga.
m.e: Because I don't want you to have to look after me, and... I never want to be a burden.

m.e: The infant has faith in his mother taking care of him.

m.e: So be a nice chap and take good care of her.

m.e: Relax now and let me take care of you.

m.e: I don't want a stranger taking care of my family.

m.e: He's asked me to look after her while she's in London.

m.t: Cuido las casas de nuestros vecinos cuando salen de la ciudad.
m.e: I take care of our neighbors' houses when they go out of town.

m.e: Fine, then you go and I'll watch the boy.

m.e: I watch my sister's kids all the time.

m.t: El hecho es que no cuido de su ropa.
m.e: The fact is, I don't look after his clothes.

m.t: Cuido a mi gente lo mejor que puedo.
m.e: I look after my people as best I can.

m.t: Cuido de ella todo el tiempo.
m.e: That's her. I look after her all the time.

m.t: Porque al contrario que ellos, yo cuido verdaderamente de él.
m.e: Because unlike them, I genuinely care for him.

m.t: No soy yo mismo, en todos los aspectos.

m.e: To know some aspects of ourselves that we don't like and don't want to admit.
